findings.statement: Newly added A1 §2.6 rule MIN-3 asserts without exception that when a gate fires, endpoint_reached = 0 and MPFED = NULL, and the new A1 §8 bullet restates it as an unconditional prohibition. A2 §1.5.1a (EXC-2 / E-5 / E-6a / E-6b) requires the opposite for FINANCIAL_ACTION_ENTRY (login or identity gate, kind confirmed) and COMMUNICATION_ENTRY (login gate, kind confirmed): endpoint_reached = 1 and MPFED = integer m, where m is exactly the gate-reaching terminal length A1 §8 now forbids assigning.
findings.evidence: A1 §2.6 (lines 306-430) contains zero occurrences of FINANCIAL_ACTION_ENTRY, COMMUNICATION_ENTRY, 'A2 §1.5.1a', 'E-5' or 'E-6' (grep-verified). A2 §0 item 3 ranks A1 at 8 and A2 at 9, and §2.6 is absent from both jurisdiction tables, so the conflict resolves toward MIN-3. No §6.3 guard catches under-promotion: E-6a/E-6b guards fail one direction only (over-promotion), and none of I-42..I-53 asserts that a confirmed gate must promote.
findings.impact: Reinstates in A1 exactly proposition 3 of ssot-00-3-auth-gate-endpoint-contradicts-a2-1-5-1, which this auditor closed one commit earlier at 68a715bb: MPFED becomes structurally NULL for both archetypes, so 00 §7 ExcessDepth baselines, 00 §11 per-archetype Depth distributions and 01 §10 mart_archetype_summary do not hold for those two rows.
remedy: put the two-archetype exception into MIN-3 and delegate with the same wording A1 §1.5 already uses ('분기 규칙의 정본은 A2 §1.5.1a 규칙 E-5~E-10')

findings.statement: A1 §6.2 is the runner-facing authority for evidence identity and its convention table says only '재수집은 새 evidence_run_id 를 만든다'; A1 §6.3 then consumes evidence_run_id as a free input to the observation_id hash. After C-2's option (a), every run including the first must have evidence_run_id equal to f(ledger_record_sha256, countersign_commit_sha, execution_index) (A2 §1.11.2 RC-6, checks A-6/A-7). A1 says so nowhere.
findings.impact: Not a contradiction — A1 does not assert the id is free, and the §6.3 guard is fail-closed, so no bad evidence escapes. But an implementer working from A1 alone mints a free id and has the whole run rejected at E001 submission time. Hence E001_V2-blocking, not V2_SSOT_FROZEN-blocking.
findings.remedy: add one binding row to the A1 §6.2 convention table: evidence_run_id is not a free identifier — it is the image of A2 §1.11.2 RC-6 derivation f, and this applies to the first run as well.
